description:
[narrowed from route-edit-444af398] investigate and decompose gap route-edit-d1594350: Stop the gap store from silently destroying itself in repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/substrate-gap.ts.

Measured incident, 2026-09-09: the gap store went from 4,113 rows to 44 in a single day. Cause: loadGaps() returns an EMPTY array on ANY read or parse failure, and the store is a read-modify-write - load, mutate, save. So one corrupt or transiently unreadable gaps.json yields [], and

WHY PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS ON THIS GAP FAILED (most recent last):
- compose_execution_failure: {"error":"no_unique_anchor: refused fs_edit — planned anchor is non-unique and re-derivation found no unique substring (would mislocalize to first occurrence)"}
- syntax_break: src/resolvers/substrate-gap.ts(770,5): error TS1128: Declaration or statement expected. | src/resolvers/substrate-gap.ts(782,9): error TS1005: '{' expected. | src/resolvers/substrate-gap.ts(828,3): er

Do not repeat these failures. Address the specific cause named above.
